title.en: A note to my younger self
title.es: Una nota para mi yo del pasado

es: Escribir una carta a su yo del pasado combinando condicionales mixtos, supposing, even if y should.

teaching.en: If I had taken that chance, I would be happier today.
teaching.es: Si hubiera aprovechado esa oportunidad, hoy sería más feliz.
teaching.explanationEs: Condicional mixto: if + had + participio, would + verbo base (causa pasada, efecto de hoy).
segments: If I had taken that chance,
teaching.audioText: If I had taken that chance, I would be happier today.

teaching.en: Supposing you feel afraid, remember that every mistake is a lesson.
teaching.es: Suponiendo que tengas miedo, recuerda que cada error es una lección.
teaching.explanationEs: Supposing + presente plantea una situación posible para dar un consejo.
segments: Supposing you feel afraid, remember that
teaching.audioText: Supposing you feel afraid, remember that every mistake is a lesson.

teaching.en: Trust yourself: even if people laugh at your dream, it is worth trying.
teaching.es: Confía en ti: aunque se rían de tu sueño, vale la pena intentarlo.
teaching.explanationEs: Even if + presente: ánimo que no depende de la condición.
segments: Trust yourself: even if people laugh at
your dream, it is worth trying.
teaching.audioText: Trust yourself: even if people laugh at your dream, it is worth trying.

teaching.en: Should you ever doubt yourself, remember that I am proud of you.
teaching.es: Si alguna vez dudas de ti, recuerda que estoy orgulloso de ti.
teaching.explanationEs: Should + sujeto: una posibilidad remota, en tono amable y algo formal.
segments: Should you ever doubt yourself, remember
that I am proud of you.
teaching.audioText: Should you ever doubt yourself, remember that I am proud of you.

teaching.en: My biggest regret is that I never had the courage to try.
teaching.es: Mi mayor arrepentimiento es que nunca tuve el valor de intentarlo.
teaching.explanationEs: Regret y courage ayudan a expresar el lamento que motiva los consejos.
segments: My biggest regret is that I
never had the courage to try.
teaching.audioText: My biggest regret is that I never had the courage to try.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase une una causa pasada con un resultado de hoy?

choices.text: If I had studied more, I would have a better job today.
If I study more, I will have a better job.
If I studied more, I would get a better job.

feedback.es: El condicional mixto usa if + had + participio para el pasado y would + verbo base para el presente.

hint.es: Busca if + had + participio y would + verbo base.

prompt.es: Completa: «Aunque tengas miedo, vale la pena intentarlo.»

feedback.es: Even if significa «aunque» y va seguido de un verbo en presente.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase es una hipótesis para dar un consejo?

choices.text: If you had felt afraid, you would be here now.
Supposing you feel afraid, remember that I believe in you.

feedback.es: Supposing + presente plantea una situación posible y a continuación llega el consejo.

hint.es: Supposing + presente propone una situación posible.

prompt.es: En la carta, ¿qué frase expresa un arrepentimiento por algo pasado?

choices.text: Even if it is difficult, keep going.
Should you ever feel lost, remember that I am proud of you.
If I had worked harder at school, I would have more choices today.

feedback.es: «If I had worked harder… I would have more choices today» lamenta algo del pasado que afecta a hoy: es el condicional mixto.

origin.text: Dear Ana, I am writing from the future. If I had worked harder at school, I would have more choices today. Even if it is difficult, keep going. Should you ever feel lost, remember that I am proud of you.

choices.text: To keep trying after a bad result.
To stop studying for a while.

origin.audio: Even if you get bad marks on your first exam, try again. It is worth it.

origin.text: If I hadn't lost that chance, I ___ a different job today.

prompt.es: Escribe una nota a tu yo del pasado, de 90 a 140 palabras.

answer.text: Dear me, I am writing to you from the future. If I had taken more chances at school, I would be more confident today. I regret that I never had the courage to try new things, and I know it is hard. Supposing you feel afraid before an exam, remember that every mistake is a lesson. Even if people laugh at your dreams, it is worth trying. Trust yourself, because you are stronger than you think. Should you ever doubt yourself, read this letter again. I am proud of you, and I will always be on your side. Remember to be kind to yourself. Love, me.
accepted: Dear me, I am writing to you from the future. If I had taken more chances at school, I would be more confident today. I regret that I never had the courage to try new things, and I know it is hard. Supposing you feel afraid before an exam, remember that every mistake is a lesson. Even if people laugh at your dreams, it is worth trying. Trust yourself, because you are stronger than you think. Should you ever doubt yourself, read this letter again. I am proud of you, and I will always be on your side. Remember to be kind to yourself. Love, me.

Dear me, I am writing to you from the future. If I had worked harder at school, I would have more choices today. My biggest regret is that I did not have the courage to ask for help. Supposing you feel lost, remember that every mistake teaches you something. Even if it is difficult, it is worth trying. Trust yourself, because you can do more than you think. Should you ever doubt yourself, read this letter again. I am proud of you, and I know you can do it. Remember to be kind to yourself. Love, me.

feedback.es: La carta necesita los cuatro condicionales: mixto para el lamento, supposing para el consejo, even if para el ánimo y should para el cierre.

origin.text: Escribe a tu yo de quince años. Incluye: (1) un condicional mixto sobre algo que no hiciste y cómo sería tu vida hoy; (2) un consejo con supposing; (3) ánimo con even if; (4) un cierre amable con should.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase es un consejo formal para una posibilidad remota?

choices.text: If you ever feel alone, you would call a friend.
Should you ever feel alone, call a friend.
You should ever feel alone, call a friend.

feedback.es: Should + sujeto + verbo base plantea la posibilidad remota y el consejo va en imperativo.

feedback.es: Supposing + presente plantea la situación posible antes del consejo.
